subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar expose `guard` as a stable public automation contract with the proposed provider/window names, exit codes, timeout, and fail-open semantics?
rationale: This adds a durable scripting interface rather than repairing an established broken contract; only maintainers can choose whether its behavior and compatibility promise belong in the CLI.

options.title: Approve the proposed contract
options.body: Accept the documented exit-code and quota-window semantics, then require configured-account proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Limit supported providers or window semantics before merge if the current generic names overpromise provider-specific quota behavior.

options.title: Defer the command
options.body: Keep quota reporting passive and close or rework the proposal if a script-gating contract is outside the intended CLI scope.

recommendation.title: Approve the proposed contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented exit-code and quota-window semantics, then require configured-account proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest branch hardening commits attributed to steipete are the clearest available evidence of ownership of the final CLI contract.
